scares.description: Mr. Veeck stands up in the elevator as Dahlia looks through the window.
The elevator door begins to close suddenly.
Mr. Veeck comes into view behind Dahlia.
Dahlia turns a corner and runs into two teenagers.
The reflection of one of the teenagers can be seen in the washing machine window.
Dahlia looks into the washing machine window and briefly sees an image of a screaming girl.
Dahlia sees a drowned girl in the water tank, the girl suddenly opens her eyes.
